import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessor


class DimuonAnalysisProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for PocketCoffea."""
    
    def object_preselection(self, df, cut_flow):
        """Build MuonGood collection: pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muon_mask = (df.Muon.pt > 15) & (abs(df.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        df["MuonGood"] = df.Muon[muon_mask]
        return df, cut_flow
    
    def object_counting(self, df, cut_flow):
        """Store the number of selected muons per event"""
        df["n_muons_good"] = ak.num(df.MuonGood)
        return df, cut_flow
